toddlers.purpose: 'toddlers' category word/dot only — never as text on a light ground (use ink-toddler).

ink-toddler.purpose: Accent-warm TEXT on a light ground (Meet / everyday eyebrows, form error) — darkened toddler-orange, >=4.5:1 on cloud-white.

mark-water.purpose: Fill of the Water (H₂O) ingredient mark — darkened Baby Blue so cloud-white mark text meets AA.

mark-salt.purpose: Fill of the Salt (NaCl) ingredient mark — darkened Toddler Orange so cloud-white mark text meets AA.

on-ink-muted.purpose: Dimmed text on --ink sections (microcopy, disclaimer) — a solid tint, never opacity.

strike.purpose: Line-through RULE on the struck regular price (the struck text itself is cloud-white).

display.purpose: The hero headline only; splits into a Quicksand bold line and an italic Lora second line.

title.purpose: Ingredient card names, success-panel heading, FAQ answer parents (h3).

body.purpose: All paragraph copy; Quicksand at weight 500.

supporting.purpose: Italic Lora for pull-quotes and one-line warm asides.

label.purpose: Uppercase Montserrat for eyebrows, chips, button text, banners.

shadows.name: soft-ambient
shadows.purpose: The resting shadow. Lifts cards, the signup success panel, use-case tiles, and the hero badge above a section band.

shadows.name: diagram-float
shadows.purpose: Softer variant applied as a filter to the transparent HOCl diagram PNG so it floats without a card.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Button :hover only — a response to state. On --ink: 0 14px 30px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.5).

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Email input :focus-visible ring, on top of the standard focus outline.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll entrance for section blocks (JS adds .has-reveal). prefers-reduced-motion: skipped.

motion.name: success-settle
motion.purpose: Signup confirmation card settles in with a self-drawing checkmark.

motion.name: faq-open
motion.purpose: FAQ answer fade/rise on open. prefers-reduced-motion: skipped.

motion.name: hint-nudge
motion.purpose: The 'Swipe' arrow hint on mobile carousels; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Ghost Button

Water

The gentle base of our formula.

narrative.overview:
The page reads like a bright, open sky. Wide bands of soft Background Blue and Cloud White stack down the scroll, each one a calm field with room to breathe; a single rounded wave marks the one transition where the ground changes from sky to cream, echoing the bottle label. Everything is rounded — pill buttons, 22px cards, circular ingredient marks — and nothing has a hard edge or a sharp corner. The mood is calm, tender, honest, and quietly premium. Warmth comes from real photography of little hands in natural light set against the cool sky palette; structure comes from generous whitespace, not rules or boxes.

The deliberate opposite of this system is the clinical germ-fear sanitizer look: warning reds and greens, shield and germ iconography, "kills 99.9%" urgency, sharp edges, and hospital whites. Playdate never raises its voice. Where a fear brand would shout a threat, this design leaves quiet space and lets a plain sentence of navy Quicksand do the work.

Type is a three-voice pairing: rounded Quicksand for every headline and the wordmark, utilitarian Montserrat in all-caps for eyebrows, chips, and button labels, and italic Lora for the warm human asides. Depth is minimal — surfaces are flat, lifted only by one soft blue ambient shadow on cards and the signup success card.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating Background Blue / Cloud White / Primary Ink section bands as the primary structural device
Everything rounded: pill buttons and inputs (100px), 22px cards, circular marks
One soft ambient shadow, used sparingly; otherwise flat
Three type voices with fixed jobs: Quicksand display, Montserrat labels, Lora warmth
Real warm-toned photography of little hands against the cool palette
Accent colors appear only as the baby·kids·toddlers set, never as large fields

rules.name: The Let-the-Sky-Breathe Rule
rules.body: Roughly 70% of any screen is Background Blue and Cloud White ground, ~20% is navy ink, and no more than ~10% is accent-color pop. The three accents appear together as the baby·kids·toddlers set, sparingly, and never as a large color field — no full-width accent sections, no accent-colored panels. Their rarity is what makes them read as playful rather than loud.

rules.name: The Navy-Carries-the-Words Rule
rules.body: Text is Primary, Secondary, or Accent Ink (or Cloud White on ink grounds) — never a raw category accent. Accent-warm copy uses the darkened text-safe sibling (--ink-toddler), never --toddlers / --baby themselves. Accents are fills behind navy text or small graphic marks.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Every piece of text is Quicksand (headings + body), Montserrat (uppercase labels only), or italic Lora (warm asides only). A fourth treatment, or Lora set upright, or Montserrat in sentence case, is off the system.

rules.name: The Short-Caps Rule
rules.body: All-caps + wide tracking is for labels of a few words. Never set a full sentence or a multi-item list in uppercase.

rules.name: The Flat-Field Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The soft ambient shadow appears only on genuine cards floating above a section band. Shadow may appear as a response to state (button hover, input focus) and nowhere else. No borders used as fake elevation; dividers are 1px color-mix hairlines at ~12–16% ink.

rules.name: The Exhale Rule
rules.body: Motion follows one thesis — the page exhales as you scroll. Gentle entrance (blocks rise 14px + fade, once) and state feedback (hover lift, FAQ open, a confirmation checkmark) only. No parallax, scroll-jacking, marquee, or looping decoration. Every animation is gated on prefers-reduced-motion, and the reduced path keeps each state change instantly.

dos: Do alternate --blue / --cloud / --ink section bands so no two neighbors share a ground, and give each band clamp(3rem, 8vw, 5.5rem) vertical padding.
Do keep every corner rounded — pill (100px) for interactive/label elements, 22px for cards, 50% for marks and bullets.
Do use the soft ambient shadow (0 18px 40px -24px rgba(8,57,124,.35)) only on cards that float above a band.
Do hold text to Primary/Secondary/Accent Ink (or Cloud White on ink), and put the category accents behind navy text or into small marks.
Do keep the accent trio together and rare (the Let-the-Sky-Breathe Rule): ~70% blue/white ground, ~20% navy, <=10% accent.
Do set warm real photography of little hands in natural light against the cool palette; keep the product on hands/skin only.
Do reserve italic Lora for pull-quotes and one-line warm asides.
donts: Don't use a raw category accent (#24A8DA / #F6CF69 / #DF6334) as a text color on a light ground — use --ink-toddler for accent-warm text, or keep the accent as a fill.
Don't paint a large surface (a full section, a wide panel) in an accent color; accents are pops, not fields.
Don't add a colored border-left/-right above 1px to a card, list item, callout, or note — the side-tab is the classic AI-UI tell; use a hairline footnote instead.
Don't add a resting shadow tier beyond the soft ambient, or a shadow on a button/input at rest — state-response shadow only.
Don't auto-scroll, marquee, parallax, or loop decoration; motion is for entrance and state, once, and always behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't introduce sharp corners, hard drop shadows, warning reds/greens, shields, or germ iconography — the clinical-sanitizer look is the anti-reference.
Don't set sentences or lists in all-caps; uppercase is for short Montserrat labels only.
Don't add a fourth type treatment or use Lora upright / Montserrat in sentence case.
Don't let the wave motif repeat; it appears exactly once, at the blue->cream HOCl transition.
